howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Text: Rainfall, slope data, and satellite/sensor inputs are tracked continuously across NER districts.
howItWorks.step2Text: Our model scores landslide risk (low/moderate/high) and updates the heatmap live
howItWorks.step3Title: You get alerted before it happens
howItWorks.step3Text: If your area crosses into high risk, you get an instant SMS/email warning — not after the fact.
howItWorks.step4Title: You can report what you see
howItWorks.step4Text: Spot a landslide, blocked road, or hazard? Report it in seconds to help authorities respond faster.

reportCta.title: Help Protect Your Community
reportCta.description: Spotted a hazard? Your reports help our AI and authorities respond faster to landslides, road damage, and flooding.
